title: The Fastest Way to Validate an AI Business Idea
description:
Most people think making money with AI means building a SaaS app or cloning Uber or Stripe. It doesn't. Here's the fastest way to make money with AI: pick a niche, create one offer, and validate it on a free landing page built with Google AI Studio or Claude before you build anything. It's the simplest AI business idea and AI side hustle to start an online business, and the opt-in metrics tell you whether to build the offer or move on.

Get the offer validation playbook (metrics + the landing page prompt) here: https://app.shade.inc/publish/e0955927-1425-47b0-a685-5fa1eb1090b3
